reason: The first six IDs propose the same 16-band panel32 wrapper experiment, so they are one hypothesis, not separate evidence-backed variants. Rank panel_packing first because it specifies the concrete parameter setup and full-GEMM checks; the other duplicates follow. Its benefit is unverified: the existing augmented baseline scored 1034.6–1071.2 GFLOP/s without using the helper, while the panel path adds repeated packing and 16 SME transitions. Next, b_panel_layout adds a full 1 MiB allocation and copy, and the supplied evidence does not verify that layout against the full-kernel helper ABI. a_transpose offers no distinct executable experiment beyond the panel proposals. tail_alignment affects only the fallback, not the timed n=512 path. None has candidate paired measurements, so this order reflects implementation specificity and expected cost/correctness risk, not measured benefit or causality.
